description: Press a key by name (enter, backspace, up, down, left, right, tab, escape, f1..f12, a..z, ...), with ctrl:true or shift:true held around it. A tap of ctrl+t does not terminate, as in the game: pass holdMs to hold the key down instead (key repeats every tick), and holding ctrl+t for 1000 ms or more sends `terminate`.

holdMs.description: Hold the key this long instead of tapping it.

name: craftos_key
